display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-05-D3-31 Support to the implementation of an EU policy framework for CO2 transport and storage infrastructure – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-05-D3-31 Support to the implementation of an EU policy framework for CO2 transport and storage infrastructure
executive_summary: Funds one Coordination and Support Action that helps stakeholders in the CO2 infrastructure network implement the coming EU legislative framework for CO2 infrastructure: market and cost structure, cross-border integration, interoperability, tariffs, third-party access, liability, ownership models and the repurposing of existing infrastructure. Funded as a lump sum at up to 100% for a coordination and support action; the indicative topic budget is EUR 5 million for around 1 project. Opening 2027-05-05; single-stage full proposal deadline 2027-09-15 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Work Programme Part 8, pp. 185–186, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope, funds a coordination and support action that helps stakeholders implement the coming EU legislation on CO2 transport and storage infrastructure (market and cost structure, tariffs, third-party access, liability, planning). It does not touch TenneT's electricity-transmission field: no project file is close to it, and the only link is a passing item on interconnections between CO2 and energy infrastructures, which sets no task for, and no clear benefit to, a transmission system operator.
